findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: download_object · Private data: create_bucket, upload_object, download_object · Public sink: upload_object · Destructive: delete_object.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: download_object · Private data: create_bucket, upload_object, download_object · Public sink: upload_object · Destructive: delete_object

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
